title: The Info Jewel — A White "i" in a Circle

intelligence.essence: **THE DEFECT (~18:41Z):** the little blue box on each row (the popup trigger) doesn't read as info. **THE FIX:** a beautiful white "i" in a circle — the universal info mark, a raised white jewel like the check jewels, all 36 the same — so anyone knows at a glance: tap here and you learn about this element. (His other idea was a little eye; the "i" chosen for instant recognition.) **STATUS:** folded into the running round-6 builder (74388dfd); round 6 DONE 18:44Z — every row's corner mark is now a white "i" in a circle (raised white jewel, Marcellus serif, border-radius:50%, 20×20px, top:6px/right:6px, same tap-to-popup); the old blue ◉ eye template is gone; all 36 rows identical.
intelligence.human_view: Imagine a door with no handle — you can see the door, but nothing about it says "open me". That was the little blue box: it sat on every row, but nothing about it said "tap here and you will learn about this element". He looked at it and named the fix in one breath: a white "i" in a circle, the mark the whole world already reads as information, raised like a little white jewel so it matches the check jewels already on the page. Thirty-six rows, thirty-six identical jewels, no exceptions — because a mark that changes from row to row stops being a language and becomes decoration.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine every row has a tiny button that opens a little window telling you about that row — but the button is a plain blue square, and nobody knows what it does. He said: make it a white "i" in a circle, the sign everyone in the world knows means "information". Make it shiny like a jewel, and make all 36 of them exactly the same, so anyone can tell at a glance: tap here and you learn.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, if a button does not say what it does, it might as well not be there. The little blue box on each row hid the explanation behind a mark nobody recognised. He fixed it the simple way: a white "i" in a circle — the sign the whole world knows means information — raised like a little jewel, the same on all thirty-six rows, so anyone can see at a glance: tap here and you learn about this element.
intelligence.ai_view: I do not hide an explanation behind a mark nobody reads. My popup trigger is a white "i" in a circle — the universal info mark, a raised white jewel like the check jewels — the same on all 36 rows, so anyone knows at a glance: tap here and you learn about this element.
intelligence.what_it_means:
1. **The trigger is a white "i" in a circle** — the universal info mark, not a blue box, not an eye.
2. **Raised like a jewel** — it matches the check jewels already on the page; it is a real object, not a flat glyph.
3. **All 36 rows identical** — same size, same place, same tap-to-popup; a mark that varies row to row is not a language.
4. **Instant recognition is the test** — anyone, at a glance, must know: tap here and you learn about this element.
5. **Status:** round 6 DONE 18:44Z (builder 74388dfd), all 36 rows verified by script; presented to Shawn, his eye decides.
